parsed.why: No criminalisation, GI/gender-expression antidiscrimination law, legal recognition; Pride 2023 violence investigated and condemned by officials, but protections are vague, rarely enforced, and bias incidents and under-reported violence are documented.

No criminalisation and bias-grounds conviction in 2023 show some working recourse, but severe recent societal hostility, ineffective hate-speech prosecution, municipal official hostility, no functioning gender recognition for travellers' documents.

No criminalisation, but no discrimination recourse outside HIV law, no hate-crime provision, police history of breaking up Pride and harassing LGBTQ visibility, and deeply hostile dated polling; gaps and hostility, little documented remedy.

Same-sex conduct criminalised with 2023 arrests and convictions, one death in custody, presidential call to stone gay people, torture and extrajudicial-killing context, no legal recognition; state targeting of gender-nonconforming people.

Universal traveller-facing exposure: X-marker passports refused, sex-discrepancy screening and fraud findings, facility bans in many states with a trespass arrest, birth-sex custody harm, counterterror framing — courts only partly mitigate.
